decisions.headline: 《沙丘：觉醒》登陆Xbox Series X|S并加入完整单人模式
decisions.summary: 《沙丘：觉醒》现已登陆 Xbox Series X|S。此次版本加入完整单人模式，可从3档难度预设中选择或逐项自定义玩法；阵营终局系统 Landsraad 也重制为任务驱动结构，并支持单人及多人 PvE。
decisions.verification: Xbox Wire 一手文章明确确认 Xbox Series X|S 上线、完整单人模式、3档难度预设与重制后的 Landsraad。
decisions.reason: 窗口内一手上线公告，主体、平台和核心新增内容均清晰。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布于北京时间9月22日20:00，文中以“today”确认同日上线。

decisions.headline: 《断曲余音》登陆PS5，试玩版同步开放
decisions.summary: Emeteria 开发的元素动作冒险 RPG《断曲余音》现已登陆 PS5，试玩版同步上线。玩家扮演 One，在遭到 Paradox 侵蚀的 Corel 世界操纵名为 Æther 的水元素，并通过切换现实解决战斗、探索与谜题。
decisions.verification: PlayStation Blog 的开发团队一手文章确认 PS5 上线、试玩版开放、主角与核心元素玩法。
decisions.reason: 窗口内一手上线公告，主体、平台与玩法信息完整。
decisions.timeNote: 来源发布于北京时间9月22日23:00，文中以“today”确认同日上线。

en.archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Dune: Awakening Launches on Xbox With Full Single-Player Mode

entries.headline: Dune: Awakening Launches on Xbox Series X|S With a Full Single-Player Mode
entries.summary: Dune: Awakening is now available on Xbox Series X|S. The release adds a full single-player mode with three difficulty presets or detailed gameplay customization, while the Landsraad endgame has been rebuilt as a mission-driven framework for both solo and multiplayer PvE.
entries.verification: The opened Xbox Wire article directly confirms the Xbox Series X|S launch, full single-player mode, three difficulty presets, and rebuilt Landsraad.
entries.timeNote: The source was published at 8:00 PM Beijing time on September 22 and identifies the launch as occurring that day.

entries.headline: Fading Echo Launches on PS5 Alongside a Playable Demo
entries.summary: Emeteria’s elemental action-adventure RPG Fading Echo is now available on PS5, with a demo released at the same time. Players control One in the Paradox-stricken world of Corel, manipulating the water element known as Æther and shifting between realities across combat, exploration, and puzzles.
entries.verification: The opened PlayStation Blog article from the development team directly confirms the PS5 launch, demo, protagonist, and central elemental mechanics.
entries.timeNote: The source was published at 11:00 PM Beijing time on September 22 and identifies the launch as occurring that day.

checked: Reviewed the packet’s September 24–October 8 calendar baseline and discovery summary.
limited: Every discovery family is marked partial and 78 candidates were omitted; unopened or conflicting leads were not promoted into calendar patches.
sourceReport.note: No calendar patch was submitted because this pass did not establish a new or changed item from an opened first-party product or publisher page.

checkedExtra: 逐项审阅5个候选包，并对144个历史跟踪项给出继续或关闭决定。
核对 packet 的 future-15-day refreshRange、既有基线与 discovery 覆盖摘要。
limitedExtra: 各平台 upcomingDiscovery 均为 partial，且 omittedCandidates=78；未把未打开的一手线索写入日历。
三项候选存在主体身份阻塞或不构成离散事件，未自行补造身份。
editorialNote: Canonical 决定严格绑定不可变 packet：收录2条、排除1条、待复核146条；未提交日历补丁或删除项。
